name: Augmented SDF
aliases: Conservative SDF Construction from Bounding Volume
definition: An augmented signed distance function fe that embeds a bounding volume (convex polyhedra or ellipsoids) to speed up queries by avoiding expensive SDF evaluations outside the bound.
summary: Augmented SDF accelerates field queries by returning the distance to a conservative geometric bounding volume for points far from the surface, avoiding expensive SDF evaluations.
